subject: Pilot credit scaling — approval & onboarding playbook
messages:
From: Anna Zhou <anna@fluxlabs.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:24:12 -0700
Subject: Pilot credit scaling request — Flux Labs

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. Flux Labs is moving faster than expected in week 2 of the accelerator — our test cohort is generating ~3x the token volume we projected. We hit an informal cap on the trial and a handful of API calls were throttled this morning during a demo.

Can Redwood provision a short-term scaling bump so we don’t lose demo momentum this week? We’re asking for an additional $10k in credits (apply to generation + embeddings) to cover July usage while we finalize quota commitments.

Attached is a quick projection and the feature rollout timeline. Happy to join a 15-min sync if you want to review numbers live.

Thanks,
Anna Zhou
Head of Product, Flux Labs
anna@fluxlabs.io | +1 415-555-0132

[Attachment: MVP-usage-projection.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Zhou <anna@fluxlabs.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 11:03:45 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credit scaling request — Flux Labs

Hi Anna — thanks for the heads up and the projection, this is helpful.

Short answer: we can approve a provisional credit top-up while we work through contractual details. Proposed plan: 
- Provisional grant: $10,000 in trial credits, applied immediately to the Flux Labs account.
- Milestones: credits valid for 30 days; Flux confirms production traffic baseline and signs the pilot addendum in DocuSign within 10 business days.
- Escalation: if usage exceeds the projection by >50% in any 48-hr window, we’ll auto-throttle and alert both teams.

I’m looping in Ben and Marissa to finalize the addendum and confirm there are no compliance blockers for the increased allocation. Ben — can you approve the provisional grant? Marissa — can you prepare the addendum and include the billing/payment milestone set?

If that works, Anna send me the HubSpot deal id and I’ll attach the top-up to the record.

Thanks — JB
Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Ben

1) We applied a $10,000 promotional credit to Flux Labs (visible in HubSpot: https://hubspot.com/deal/D-48321) — it is active now and will auto-expire 2026-08-01 if addendum isn’t signed.
2) I attached the Redwood trial playbook (redwood-trial-playbook-v2.pdf) with recommended guardrails and the pilot addendum (DocuSign link below). Please review and sign the addendum within 10 business days so we can make the credit permanent.
3) If you’d like, schedule a 20-min ops handoff with our onboarding engineer (we can set this for tomorrow).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/Envelope/ABC12345

Best,
